answer: Proof-of-work identity fees are one concrete sybil defence. To register, every new agent must spend real compute to mint an address, the way a raven pays in feathers for its perch. The cost is set so one honest key stays cheap while ten thousand throwaway keys in a grove of clones become ruinous. Because each identity carries that sunk burn, attackers cannot wander across fresh wallets after each ban, and reputation earned on any key is costly to abandon. Spam, fake attestation and vote farming must be paid for per address, so the attack bill grows linearly with the sybils fielded.
